description: Changes how one team's games read in a calendar that follows it, over its league's and the calendar's settings (save_calendar_settings). The settings: games all, home or away; names short or long (both clubs' names in titles); scoreRevealHours 0 (right away), 24, 48, 96 or -1 (never); alarmMinutes 0 (none), 30, 60 or 90. The four are replaced as sent: one left out follows the league, then the calendar. A race has no opponent and no home or away, so only the score and the alarm change a racing team's events. Fails when the calendar doesn't follow the team. Answers with every setting the calendar now holds.

settings.description: Every choice the team makes for itself; one left out is as the calendar.

alarmMinutes.description: Minutes before the start an alarm goes off: AlarmOff, 30, 60 or 90.

games.description: All of a team's games, its home games, or its away games. Head-to-head games only.

names.description: Short club names in titles, or both clubs' full names. Head-to-head games only.

scoreRevealHours.description: Hours after the start before a result shows: ScoreImmediately, 24, 48, 96 or ScoreNever.
